50552816.protein: Induced myeloid leukemia cell differentiation protein Mcl-1
50552816.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to human Mcl1 by isothermal titration calorimetry

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: The ITC experiments were performed on a MicroCal VP-ITC instrument (Malvern Instruments, Inc., Northampton, MA) at 25 °C. The protein (Mcl-1, 100 μM) was dialyzed against 20 mM HEPES, 100 mM NaCl, 1 mM DTT, pH 7.4, and degassed before being loaded into the sample cell. The ligand (compound 6 or 7, 1.5 mM) was dissolved in the same buffer and loaded into the syringe. The titration consisted of 20 injections of 2 μL each, with a 120 s spacing between injections. The data were analyzed using Origin 7.0 software (OriginLab, Northampton, MA) with a one-site binding model. The control experiment involved titrating the ligand into buffer alone to correct for the heat of dilution. The binding affinity (Kd) was calculated from the ITC data.

assay_conditions.buffer_composition: 20 mM HEPES, 100 mM NaCl, 1 mM DTT
assay_conditions.control_method: Titration of ligand into buffer alone to correct for the heat of dilution
